skills.name: sync-test-push
skills.proposal: description: Bring the branch up to date with origin/main, run the tests, and push only when they pass. Use when the owner asks to ship or push a small change.
skills.why_not_covered: No installed skill covers fetch, rebase, test and push as one step; the closest, commit-commands, does not run tests.

skills.reason: A one-off correction, not a repeatable workflow.
